Get documentation for a resource

Usage: slipway explain [OPTIONS] <TYPE>[.FIELD]...

Arguments:
  <TYPE>  The resource type, then the dotted path of a field, such as project.spec.syncPolicy

Options:
      --recursive  Print the name of all the fields recursively
  -h, --help       Print help (see more with '--help')

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
